# powerhmc_sys_on_off (Action)

Action that can perform power on or shutdown for a Power Server (managed system / CEC).

Actions are invoked by declaring an `action "powerhmc_sys_on_off" "<name>" { config { ... } }` block and triggering it at a resource lifecycle event with a `lifecycle { action_trigger { ... } }` block on that resource. Actions require Terraform v1.14 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Power a whole managed system (CEC) on or off. Actions run at lifecycle
# events via the `action_trigger` lifecycle block on a resource.

# Power on a managed system.
action "powerhmc_sys_on_off" "power_on" {
  config {
    name      = "Server-9009-22A-SN123456"
    operation = "on" # "on" | "off" | "onstandby" | "onhwdisc" | "onstartpolicy"
    timeout   = 15   # minutes, 10-60
  }
}

# Immediate power off with restart. `restart` requires `immed = true`, and
# both `immed` and `restart` only apply to the "off" operation.
action "powerhmc_sys_on_off" "power_cycle" {
  config {
    name      = "Server-9009-22A-SN123456"
    operation = "off"
    immed     = true
    restart   = true
    timeout   = 30
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the power server as it shows in HMC
- `operation` (String) Power operation to perform. Valid values: `on`, `off`, `onstandby`, `onhwdisc`, `onstartpolicy`. Use `on` for power on and `off` for shutdown.

### Optional

- `force` (Boolean) Allows powering off a managed system while a dump is being offloaded to the HMC. Only works with the `off` operation. Defaults to `false`.
- `immed` (Boolean) Perform an immediate shutdown. Only works with the `off` operation. Defaults to `false`.
- `restart` (Boolean) Reboot the server. Only works with the `off` operation, and requires `immed = true`. Defaults to `false`.
- `timeout` (Number) Timeout in minutes for the power operation. Must be between 10 and 60. Defaults to 15 minutes.

## Notes

- `immed`, `restart`, and `force` only apply to the `off` operation.
- `restart` additionally requires `immed = true`.
- This action targets a whole managed system (CEC) — not to be confused with `powerhmc_partition_power_on_off`, which targets individual LPAR/VIOS partitions.
- `timeout` must be between 10 and 60 minutes.
